description: ENDLESS CLIFFS AND VALLEYS. A warped wooden sign reads: 'The Mountains of Miserly'. The mountain itself seems to have a face carved into its side, watching your every step.

cliff_wall.description: Jagged rocky cliffs that plunge into the ocean below.

mountain_path.description: A narrow gravel path winding up the mountain peaks.

exit_south_boat.description: Your wooden boat docked at the mountain base. Ready to sail back to the Dock.

exit_north.description: A stone pass leading north into a flat, syntax-filled land.

conditions.failMessage: You cannot leave without your shoelace! You'll trip over your own sole. Talk to the Mountain to get it back.

dered_shrine.description: A ruined stone structure labeled 'The Dered Shrine'.
dered_shrine.onInteract: You step closer to the Dered Shrine. The stone blocks shift, briefly forming the shape of a tennis shoe in a tattered cape with burning red eyes. On its heel, scrawled in black sharpie, is the name: DERF. A spike of fear hits your sole.

stingy_mountain_core.description: The face of the Stingy Mountain itself.

dialogue.text: "NO VISITING FOR FREE!" the mountain booms stingily. "I have taken one of your shoelaces, white tennis shoe! If you want it back, you must give me something of equal value — a beautiful scream!" (Hint: Stand here and execute the 'scream' command!)
"AHHH, YES! STARCHY VIBRATIONS!" the mountain rumbles contentedly. Your lace magically flies back and re-threads your eyelets! "You may pass north now, travelers!"
"Keep moving, travelers. I've got enough sounds to hoard for a century!"
